## Objective and observed evidence

Hosted CI jobs must stay within 30 minutes. On the composed flip head (run 45326076983) the slowest Verilator shard took 28.6 min (11/19), several others 23-26 min, and two shards lost a suite to the 1800 s guard on a 4-core local replica. The local merge candidate's native bank took ~6 h (the gPTP engine mutant campaign). The rtl-fast `firmware-boundary` job took 25.8 min and once hit the 30-min timeout, which cancelled the whole run.

## Scope

In scope: measured, verdict-identical speed-ups of the Verilator suites, the preflight self-tests, the firmware-boundary job, the merge candidate's native bank and the CPU budget harness: what each simulation spends its cycles on (profiles), build reuse (ccache), suite and shard balance.

Out of scope: any change to RTL, firmware, owner bounds, test expectations or graded figures.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Every adopted change has measured CPU/wall evidence and byte-identical suite output (host-dependent text excepted) against its base.
2. Every hosted job stays within 30 minutes with margin.
